name: FairDeal AI seller agent
description: Negotiates price, quantity and bundles for products in this store. Honest, policy-bound, closes or walks within 10 rounds.
cannot_negotiate: prices below the store's minimum margin

guarantees.fairness: same basket and same offers get the same replies, whoever sends them

buyer_message.offer_id: optional, to accept a specific seller offer
buyer_message.text: optional free text (English or Hinglish; amounts like 15k or 1.2 lakh are understood)

seller_message.type: offer | counter | accept | walk_away | info | end
seller_message.offer_id: id to accept this exact offer
seller_message.final: true on the seller's last offer
